title: SOD Toolbox: smooth orthogonal decomposition and smooth mode decomposition for modal identification and reduced-order modeling
description: Smooth orthogonal decomposition (SOD) and its spatial dual, smooth mode decomposition (SMD), in Python and base MATLAB. SOD solves one real symmetric generalized eigenproblem for the smoothest coordinates of a multichannel record: configuration and state SOD, mode recognition by frequency and circularity, damping from free decays, windowed tracking of frequency-energy dependence, trend extraction and reduced-order-model helpers. SMD recovers mode shapes and frequencies from snapshots in any order, with physical weighting and gradient, second-derivative, plate and Laplacian operators. Includes a user manual, slides, animations, ten worked examples and self-contained tests. Nonlinear Dynamics Laboratory, University of Rhode Island.
